The eight original entries remain byte-identical; this entry is not a relocation or recreation of any of them.
Names Worker sync and supported continue arguments after Manager staging.
The operation no longer repeats the Messages passage: it keeps one home in roles/worker.md, which is what the clause's 'nothing said twice' requires of the corpus.
Separates Curator content repair, Manager staging and Worker supported continuation.

Canonical Implementation owns task-bound own-file reads, task_doc-first edits with scoped correct-write recovery, memory as read-only context, truthful report/check evidence and direct freeze delivery; generated copies add no independent authority.

1.note: Worker first tells Manager to start Reviewer at freeze, then hands that Reviewer the exact freeze and journal records directly once the seat exists. After code PASS and Curator start, its exact-freeze producer list goes directly to Curator.

2.note: The candidate stays uncommitted and the seat starts no role and stages nothing.

3.note: A hand-over counts only on a reply naming its exact object; busy refusals are retried.

4.note: The authored source owns this contract; the distribution copy is not a separate authority.

5.note: The Worker-only operation now carries conditional sync, direct repair and per-finding freeze evidence; its all-role audience marker adds no other seat.

6.note: Worker distinguishes a clean sync from an overlapping path or failing focused test, and repairs owned findings without prior approval.

7.note: Each repaired finding has its own freeze entry; code PASS carries the same entries and changed paths directly to Curator.
